name: At what stage of a remodel is kitchen finish carpentry completed?

mainEntity.name: At what stage of a remodel is kitchen finish carpentry completed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry is typically scheduled after cabinet installation, drywall finishing, and initial painting, but before final wall touch-ups and flooring transitions. In most remodels, cabinets must be leveled and secured first so moldings, decorative end panels, and scribed filler pieces align accurately. If you install crown molding before cabinets are anchored, uneven lines will show immediately. Hardwood or tile flooring is usually in place prior to toe kicks and baseboards, allowing trim carpenters to conceal floor expansion gaps. Coordinating this exact order prevents costly tear-outs or damaged trim during countertop and appliance delivery.
acceptedAnswer.description: It happens after drywall, paint, and cabinet installation, but right before final floor shoe moldings and punch-list touch-ups.
